notes: Definition change, equivalent: in `UnimodGenus` the hypothesis `Submodule.IsLattice E N` becomes `Submodule.IsFullLattice E N`. The module compiles unchanged, but Mathlib #44365 renamed the pinned `IsLattice` (finitely generated and spanning) to `IsFullLattice` and reused the name `IsLattice` for a weaker notion without `span_eq_top`, so the unchanged text would silently quantify over the weaker notion. Here `N : Submodule (𝓞 E) (Sp E n)` and `E` is the fraction field of `𝓞 E`, so `IsFullLattice E N ↔ N.FG ∧ span E N = ⊤`, which is the pinned definition, because `Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg` supplies the new linear-independence field.
